response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a full-stack developer with strong technical depth in multiple languages and paradigms, but his resume shows limited direct experience with core JVM tooling, enterprise Java/Kotlin IDE development, or deep integration with Spring/Quarkus ecosystems. While his Java experience is present (e.g., National Instruments), it appears dated and not aligned with modern enterprise tooling. His strengths lie in web and systems programming, which are valuable but not directly transferable to the IDE/tooling domain.
strengths: Strong multi-language expertise across web, mobile, and systems domains
Proven ability to design and maintain large-scale, scalable systems
Demonstrated interest in developer tooling and automation (e.g., MCP, CI/CD, testing frameworks)
concerns: Limited direct experience with JVM tooling, enterprise frameworks (Spring/Quarkus), or IDE development
Java/Kotlin expertise appears outdated or not recently applied in enterprise contexts
No clear evidence of collaboration on large-scale IDE or language server projects
